# jplot

Jplot tracks expvar-like (JSON) metrics and plot their evolution over time right into your iTerm2, Kitty terminal, or terminals with DRCS Sixel Graphics support.

![](doc/demo.gif)

Above capture is jplot monitoring a Go service's expvar:

```
jplot --url http://:8080/debug/vars \
    memstats.HeapSys+memstats.HeapAlloc+memstats.HeapIdle+marker,counter:memstats.NumGC \
    counter:memstats.TotalAlloc \
    memstats.HeapObjects \
    memstats.StackSys+memstats.StackInuse
```

By default, jplot uses the full size of the terminal, but it is possible to limit the render to a few rows:

![](doc/rows.gif)

## Install

Using homebrew:

```
brew install rs/tap/jplot
```

This tool works with [iTerm2](https://www.iterm2.com), [Kitty](https://sw.kovidgoyal.net/kitty/), [Warp](https://www.warp.dev/), or terminals that support DRCS Sixel Graphics.

## Usage

Given the following JSON output:

```
{
    "mem": {
        "Heap": 1234,
        "Sys": 4321,
        "Stack": 203
    },
    "cpu": {
        "STime": 123,
        "UTime":1234
    },
    "Threads": 2
}
```

You can graph the number of thread over time:

```
jplot --url http://:8080/debug/vars Threads
```

![](doc/single.png)

Or create a graph with both Utime and Stime growth rate on the same axis by using `+` between two field paths:

```
jplot --url http://:8080/debug/vars counter:cpu.STime+counter:cpu.UTime
```

Note: the `counter:` prefix instructs jplot to compute the difference between the values instead of showing their absolute value.

![](doc/dual.png)


Or create several graphs by providing groups of fields as separate arguments; each argument creates a new graph:

```
jplot --url http://:8080/debug/vars mem.Heap+mem.Sys+mem.Stack counter:cpu.STime+cpu.UTime Threads
```

![](doc/all.png)

### Spec Syntax

Each positional arguments given to jplot create a stacked graph with the specified values. To reference the values, use JSON query syntax. Several value paths can be referenced for the same graph by using the `+` character to separate them.

In addition, each value path can be prefixed with options separated from the path by a column. Several options can be used for the same command by separating them with a comma like so: `option1,option2:value.path`.

Supported options are:
* `counter`: Computes the difference with the last value. The value must increase monotonically.
* `marker`: When the value is none-zero, a vertical line is drawn.

## Recipes

### Memstats

Here is an example command to graph a Go program memstats:

```
jplot --url http://:8080/debug/vars \
    memstats.HeapSys+memstats.HeapAlloc+memstats.HeapIdle+marker,counter:memstats.NumGC \
    counter:memstats.TotalAlloc \
    memstats.HeapObjects \
    memstats.StackSys+memstats.StackInuse
```

![](doc/memstats.png)

### Vegeta

With the help of jaggr, jplot can be used to integrate vegeta as follow:

```
echo 'GET http://localhost:8080' | \
    vegeta attack -rate 5000 -workers 100 -duration 10m | vegeta dump | \
    jaggr @count=rps \
          hist\[100,200,300,400,500\]:code \
          p25,p50,p95:latency \
          sum:bytes_in \
          sum:bytes_out | \
    jplot rps+code.hist.100+code.hist.200+code.hist.300+code.hist.400+code.hist.500 \
          latency.p95+latency.p50+latency.p25 \
          bytes_in.sum+bytes_out.sum
```

![](doc/vegeta.gif)

### Supported Terminals

* [xterm](http://invisible-island.net/xterm/)
* [iTerm2](https://www.iterm2.com/) on OSX
* [Kitty](https://sw.kovidgoyal.net/kitty/) on Linux/macOS/Windows
* [Warp](https://www.warp.dev/) on Linux/macOS/Windows
* [mintty](https://mintty.github.io/) on UNIX OSs via SSH
* [mlterm](https://sourceforge.net/projects/mlterm/) on Linux and Windows
* [RLogin](http://nanno.dip.jp/softlib/man/rlogin/) on Windows
* [yaft](http://uobikiemukot.github.io/yaft/) on Linux console
* [yaft-android](https://github.com/uobikiemukot/yaft-android) on Android
* [Tanasinn](http://saitoha.github.io/tanasinn/) on Firefox/Thunderbird

import os, pty, subprocess, time, select, fcntl, termios, struct, sys

def run_pty(args, env_extra=None, inputs=None, winsize=(24,80,640,480), wait=2):
    # winsize: rows, cols, xpix, ypix
    master, slave = pty.openpty()
    # set winsize on slave
    fcntl.ioctl(slave, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, struct.pack("HHHH", winsize[0], winsize[1], winsize[2], winsize[3]))
    env=dict(os.environ)
    env.pop("TERM_PROGRAM",None)
    if env_extra:
        for k,v in env_extra.items():
            if v is None: env.pop(k,None)
            else: env[k]=v
    p=subprocess.Popen(["./executable"]+args, stdin=slave, stdout=slave, stderr=slave, env=env, close_fds=True)
    os.close(slave)
    out=b""
    # nonblock master
    import fcntl as f
    flags=f.fcntl(master, f.F_GETFL); f.fcntl(master, f.F_SETFL, flags|os.O_NONBLOCK)
    start=time.time()
    idx=0
    # inputs: list of (delay, bytes)
    inputs = inputs or []
    # schedule absolute
    while time.time()-start < wait:
        # send due inputs
        while idx < len(inputs) and inputs[idx][0] <= time.time()-start:
            try: os.write(master, inputs[idx][1])
            except OSError as e: print("write err",e)
            idx+=1
        r,_,_=select.select([master],[],[],0.05)
        if master in r:
            try:
                data=os.read(master, 65536)
                if data: out+=data
                else: break
            except OSError:
                break
        if p.poll() is not None:
            # drain
            try:
                while True:
                    data=os.read(master,65536)
                    if not data: break
                    out+=data
            except: pass
            break
    rc=p.poll()
    if rc is None:
        p.kill()
        try: p.wait(timeout=1)

import os, pty, subprocess, time, select, fcntl, termios, struct

def run_iso(args, env_extra=None, responder='kitty_then_da', wait=3, winsize=(10,40)):
    rows, cols = winsize
    master, slave = pty.openpty()
    fcntl.ioctl(slave, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, struct.pack("HHHH", rows, cols, 0,0))
    env=dict(os.environ); env.pop("TERM_PROGRAM",None)
    if env_extra: env.update(env_extra)
    def preexec():
        os.setsid()
        fcntl.ioctl(slave, termios.TIOCSCTTY, 0)
    p=subprocess.Popen(["./executable"]+args, stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, env=env, pass_fds=(slave,), preexec_fn=preexec)
    os.close(slave)
    # set nonblock master and pipes
    for fd in [master, p.stdout.fileno(), p.stderr.fileno()]:
        fl=fcntl.fcntl(fd, fcntl.F_GETFL); fcntl.fcntl(fd, fcntl.F_SETFL, fl|os.O_NONBLOCK)
    start=time.time(); log=[]
    sent_kitty=False; sent_da=False; sent_14=False; sent_json=False
    chunks={'tty':b'','out':b'','err':b''}
    while time.time()-start<wait:
        r,_,_=select.select([master,p.stdout,p.stderr],[],[],0.02)
        for f in r:
            try: d=os.read(f.fileno() if hasattr(f,'fileno') else f, 65536)
            except: d=b''
            if not d: continue
            name='tty' if f==master else ('out' if f==p.stdout else 'err')
            chunks[name]+=d; log.append((time.time()-start,name,d))
            # respond based on cumulative tty+out
            alldata=chunks['tty']+chunks['out']
            if (not sent_kitty) and b'\x1b_Gi=1' in alldata:
                sent_kitty=True
                resp=b'\x1b_Gi=1;OK\x1b\\'
                log.append((time.time()-start,'SEND_TTY kitty',resp)); os.write(master,resp)
            if (not sent_da) and b'\x1b[c' in alldata:
                sent_da=True
                resp=b'\x1b[?62;4c'
                log.append((time.time()-start,'SEND_TTY da; also try stdin pipe?',resp)); os.write(master,resp)
            if (not sent_14) and b'\x1b[14t' in alldata:
                sent_14=True
                resp=b'\x1b[4;200;400t'
                log.append((time.time()-start,'SEND_TTY 14t',resp)); os.write(master,resp)
        if not sent_json and time.time()-start>0.5:
            sent_json=True
            p.stdin.write(b'{"a":10}\n'); p.stdin.flush(); log.append((time.time()-start,'SEND_STDIN',b'{"a":10}'))
        if p.poll() is not None: break
    rc=p.poll()
    if rc is None: p.kill(); p.wait(); rc='running'
    print("rc",rc)
    for t,k,d in log: print(f"{t:.3f} {k} len={len(d)} {d[:250]!r}")
    try: os.close(master)
    except: pass

    master, slave = pty.openpty()
    fcntl.ioctl(slave, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, struct.pack("HHHH", 10,40,0,0))
    env=dict(os.environ); env.pop("TERM_PROGRAM",None)
    if env_extra: env.update(env_extra)
    def preexec():
        os.setsid(); fcntl.ioctl(slave, termios.TIOCSCTTY, 0)
    stdin = slave if stdin_mode=='pty' else subprocess.PIPE
    stdout = slave if stdout_mode=='pty' else subprocess.PIPE
    stderr = slave if stderr_mode=='pty' else subprocess.PIPE
    p=subprocess.Popen(["./executable","-steps","5","a"], stdin=stdin, stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr, env=env, pass_fds=(slave,), preexec_fn=preexec)

    if stdout_mode=='pipe': fds[p.stdout.fileno()]='out'
    if stderr_mode=='pipe': fds[p.stderr.fileno()]='err'
    for fd in fds:

    start=time.time(); log=[]; data={k:b'' for k in fds.values()}; sent=set(); sent_json=False

import os, pty, subprocess, time, select, fcntl, termios, struct, sys
def run_manual(args, sends, env_extra=None, winsize=(10,40,0,0), wait=3, stdin_mode='pty'):
    # sends list of (t, bytes)
    rows,cols,xp,yp=winsize
    master, slave = pty.openpty()
    fcntl.ioctl(slave, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, struct.pack("HHHH", rows,cols,xp,yp))
    env=dict(os.environ); env.pop("TERM_PROGRAM",None)
    if env_extra: 
        for k,v in env_extra.items():
            if v is None: env.pop(k,None)
            else: env[k]=v
    def preexec():
        os.setsid(); fcntl.ioctl(slave, termios.TIOCSCTTY,0)
    stdin = slave if stdin_mode=='pty' else subprocess.PIPE
    p=subprocess.Popen(["./executable"]+args, stdin=stdin, stdout=slave, stderr=slave, env=env, pass_fds=(slave,), preexec_fn=preexec)
    os.close(slave)
    fl=fcntl.fcntl(master, fcntl.F_GETFL); fcntl.fcntl(master, fcntl.F_SETFL, fl|os.O_NONBLOCK)
    start=time.time(); log=[]; out=b""; sends=list(sends)
    while time.time()-start<wait:
        while sends and sends[0][0] <= time.time()-start:
            t,d=sends.pop(0); log.append((time.time()-start,'SEND',d))
            try: os.write(master,d)
            except Exception as e: log.append((time.time()-start,'ERR',str(e).encode()))
        r,_,_=select.select([master],[],[],0.01)
        if master in r:
            try:
                d=os.read(master,65536)
                if d: out+=d; log.append((time.time()-start,'RECV',d))
            except: pass
        if p.poll() is not None:
            try:
                while True:
                    d=os.read(master,65536)
                    if not d: break
                    out+=d; log.append((time.time()-start,'RECV',d))
            except: pass
            break
    rc=p.poll()
    if rc is None: p.kill(); p.wait(); rc='running'
    os.close(master)
    return rc,out,log

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp')
from isolated_harness import Harness
import subprocess, os
def run_cap(name, mode='kitty', cols=40, rows=10, pixel_reply=None, cell_reply=None, winsize_pix=(0,0), args=None):
    env={"TERM_PROGRAM":"iTerm.app"} if mode=='iterm' else None
    responder='iterm' if mode=='iterm' else mode
    kw={}
    if pixel_reply is not None: kw['pixel_reply']=pixel_reply
    if cell_reply is not None: kw['cell_reply']=cell_reply
    h=Harness(args or ["a"], responder=responder, env_extra=env, winsize=(cols,rows,winsize_pix[0],winsize_pix[1]), **kw)
    h.run_for(1.4, actions=[(0.2,lambda x:x.send_stdin(b'{"a":10}\n'))])
    open(f'/tmp/{name}.out','wb').write(h.out); open(f'/tmp/{name}.err','wb').write(h.err)
    print(name, "rc",h.p.poll(), "outlen",len(h.out), "err",h.err[:120])
    # summarize quietly to a file
    subprocess.run(["python3","/tmp/summarize.py",f'/tmp/{name}.out',f'/tmp/imgs_{name}'], stdout=open(f'/tmp/{name}.sum','w'), stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    h.kill()
    # print first image dims via Go tool if exists
    for sub in ['kitty0.bin','iterm0.bin']:
        fn=f'/tmp/imgs_{name}/{sub}'

            import struct
            d=open(fn,'rb').read(); w,hgt=struct.unpack('>II', d[16:24]); print(f"  {sub} PNG {w}x{hgt} len={len(d)}")

import subprocess, os
def run_cap(name, mode='kitty', cols=40, rows=10, pixel_reply=None, cell_reply=None, winsize_pix=(0,0), args=None):
    env={"TERM_PROGRAM":"iTerm.app"} if mode=='iterm' else None
    responder='iterm' if mode=='iterm' else mode
    kw={}
    if pixel_reply is not None: kw['pixel_reply']=pixel_reply

    h=Harness(args or ["a"], responder=responder, env_extra=env, winsize=(cols,rows,winsize_pix[0],winsize_pix[1]), **kw)
    h.run_for(1.4, actions=[(0.2,lambda x:x.send_stdin(b'{"a":10}\n'))])
    open(f'/tmp/{name}.out','wb').write(h.out); open(f'/tmp/{name}.err','wb').write(h.err)
    print(name, "rc",h.p.poll(), "outlen",len(h.out), "err",h.err[:120])
    # summarize quietly to a file
    subprocess.run(["python3","/tmp/summarize.py",f'/tmp/{name}.out',f'/tmp/imgs_{name}'], stdout=open(f'/tmp/{name}.sum','w'), stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    h.kill()
    # print first image dims via Go tool if exists
    for sub in ['kitty0.bin','iterm0.bin']:

        if os.path.exists(fn):
            import struct
            d=open(fn,'rb').read(); w,hgt=struct.unpack('>II', d[16:24]); print(f"  {sub} PNG {w}x{hgt} len={len(d)}")
    print(open(f'/tmp/{name}.sum').read()[:1000])

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp')
from isolated_harness import Harness
import json
def cap(name,args,samples,steps=5):
    a=list(args); 
    if steps is not None: a=["-steps",str(steps)]+a
    h=Harness(a,responder='kitty',winsize=(80,24,0,0))
    acts=[]
    for i,s in enumerate(samples):
        acts.append((0.1+0.05*i, lambda x,s=s: x.send_stdin((json.dumps(s)+'\n').encode())))
    h.run_for(1.4,actions=acts)
    open(f'/tmp/{name}.out','wb').write(h.out); open(f'/tmp/{name}.err','wb').write(h.err)
    print(name,h.p.poll(),len(h.out),h.err[:50])
    h.kill()
    import subprocess; subprocess.run(["python3","/tmp/summarize.py",f'/tmp/{name}.out',f'/tmp/imgs_{name}'],stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
if __name__=='__main__':
    cap('series_abs',["a+b"],samples=[{"a":10,"b":1}]*1)
    cap('series_many',["a+b+c+d+e+f+g+h+i+j"],samples=[{k:10 for k in "abcdefghij"}])
    cap('series_const50',["a"],samples=[{"a":50}]*5)
PY
python3 /tmp/cap_series.py

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp')
from isolated_harness import Harness
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer
import threading,json,time

class HH(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        n=v['n']; v['n']+=1
        print(f"{time.time()-start:.3f} HTTP #{n} val={n*100}",flush=True)
        body=json.dumps({"c":n*100}).encode(); self.send_response(200); self.send_header('Content-Length',str(len(body))); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(body)

    h.run_for(wait)
    print("frames",h.out.count(b'a=T'))

func pSteps(snap snapshot, gi int) int {
	if len(snap.graphs[gi]) == 0 {

	}
	return len(snap.graphs[gi][0])

func renderChart(img *image.NRGBA, offY, w, h int, specs []*fieldSpec, hists [][]float64) {
	if w <= 0 || h <= 0 {
		return
	}
	var series []*seriesData
	ymin := math.Inf(1)
	ymax := math.Inf(-1)
	for fi, f := range specs {
		if f.Marker {
			continue
		}
		sd := &seriesData{field: f, vals: hists[fi], color: palette[len(series)%len(palette)]}
		// Palette index is by normal-series order.
		sd.last = sd.vals[len(sd.vals)-1]
		for _, v := range sd.vals {
			if v < ymin {
				ymin = v
			}
			if v > ymax {
				ymax = v
			}
		}
		series = append(series, sd)
	}
	if len(series) == 0 {
		return
	}
	steps := len(series[0].vals)
	if ymin == ymax {
		ymin -= 0.05
		ymax += 0.05
	}

	hasMarker := false
	for fi, f := range specs {
		if f.Marker {
			for _, v := range hists[fi] {
				if v != 0 {
					hasMarker = true
				}
			}
		}
	}

	boxLeft := 12
	boxTop := offY + 10
	boxBottom := offY + h - 27
	if hasMarker {
		boxLeft = 0
		boxBottom = offY + h - 21
	}
	if boxBottom < boxTop+5 {
		boxBottom = boxTop + 5
	}
	plotH := boxBottom - boxTop

	// Y ticks.
	yIntervals := int(float64(plotH) / 36)
	if yIntervals < 1 {
		yIntervals = 1
	}
	yTickCount := yIntervals + 1
	yLabels := make([]string, yTickCount)
	maxYLabelW := 0
	for i := 0; i < yTickCount; i++ {
		v := ymax - (ymax-ymin)*float64(i)/float64(yIntervals)
		yLabels[i] = formatSI(v)
	}
	// The right margin in the reference tracks the end-point
	// labels rather than the longest intermediate label.
	for _, lab := range []string{yLabels[0], yLabels[len(yLabels)-1]} {
		if mw := measureText(lab); mw > maxYLabelW {
			maxYLabelW = mw
		}
	}
	boxRight := w - (maxYLabelW + 22)
	if boxRight < boxLeft+20 {
		boxRight = boxLeft + 20
	}
	// Axis strokes are centred on integer coordinates (two pixels

	axisLeft := float64(boxLeft) + 1
	axisRight := float64(boxRight)
	axisBottom := float64(boxBottom) + 1
	plotLeft := axisLeft
	plotRight := axisRight
	plotTopF := float64(boxTop)
	plotBottomF := float64(boxBottom)

package main

import (
	"context"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/signal"
	"strings"
	"syscall"
	"time"
)

var (
	flagInterval = flag.Duration("interval", time.Second, "When url is provided, defines the interval between fetches. Note that counter fields are computed based on this interval.")
	flagRows     = flag.Int("rows", 0, "Limits the height of the graph output.")
	flagSteps    = flag.Int("steps", 100, "Number of values to plot.")
	flagURL      = flag.String("url", "", "URL to fetch every second. Read JSON objects from stdin if not specified.")
)

func init() {
	flag.Usage = func() {
		fmt.Fprintf(flag.CommandLine.Output(), "Usage: jplot [OPTIONS] FIELD_SPEC [FIELD_SPEC...]:\n\nOPTIONS:\n")
		flag.PrintDefaults()
		fmt.Fprintf(flag.CommandLine.Output(), "\nFIELD_SPEC: [<option>[,<option>...]:]path\n  option:\n    - counter: Computes the difference with the last value. The value must increase monotonically.\n    - marker: When the value is none-zero, a vertical line is drawn.\n  path:\n    JSON field path (eg: field.sub-field).\n")
	}
}

func fatalStdout(format string, args ...interface{}) {
	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stdout, "jplot:  "+format+"\n", args...)
	os.Exit(1)
}

func prepare(rows int) {
	fmt.Fprint(os.Stderr, "\x1b[?25l")
	if rows == 0 {
		_, r, err := getWindowSize()
		if err != nil {
			fatalStdout("Cannot get window size:  %v", err)
		}
		rows = r
	}
	fmt.Fprint(os.Stderr, strings.Repeat("\n", rows))
	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stdout, "\x1b[%dA", rows)
}

func finish(rows int) {
	fmt.Fprint(os.Stderr, "\x1b[?25h")
	if rows == 0 {
		_, r, err := getWindowSize()
		if err != nil {
			fatalStdout("Cannot get window size:  %v", err)
		}
		rows = r
	}
	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stdout, "\x1b[%dB", rows)
	fmt.Fprint(os.Stderr, "\n")
}

func main() {
	flag.Parse()

	if detectedMode == modeNone {
		fatalStdout("iTerm2, Kitty, or DRCS Sixel graphics required")
	}
	if flag.NArg() == 0 {
		flag.Usage()
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	specs, err := parseSpecs(flag.Args())
	if err != nil {
		fatalStdout("Cannot parse spec:  %v", err)
	}

	ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM)
	defer stop()

	var src source
	if *flagURL != "" {
		src = newHTTPSource(ctx, *flagURL, *flagInterval)
	} else {
		if isTerminal(os.Stdin.Fd()) {
			fatalStdout("neither --url nor stdin is provided")
		}
		src = newStdinSource()
	}

	pts := newPoints(specs, *flagSteps)
	rs := &renderState{mode: detectedMode, pts: pts, rowsFlag: *flagRows}

	done := make(chan struct{})
	drawDone := make(chan bool, 1)
	go func() {
		prepared := false
		defer func() {
			if prepared {
				finish(*flagRows)
			}
			drawDone <- prepared
		}()
		ticker := time.NewTicker(time.Second)
		defer ticker.Stop()
		for {
			select {
			case <-done:
				return
			case <-ticker.C:
				if !prepared {
					prepare(*flagRows)
					prepared = true
				}
				fmt.Fprint(os.Stderr, "\x1b[s")
				rs.render()
				fmt.Fprint(os.Stderr, "\x1b[u")
			}
		}
	}()

	err = pts.Run(ctx, src)
	if err != nil {
		fatalStdout("Data source error:  %v", err)
	}

	close(done)
	prepared := <-drawDone
	if !prepared {
		rs.render()
	}
}
